text:
alex: Quick sync — telemetry handoff + retention capacity for Console observability roadmap. Two quick asks: 1) who owns the tracing hook rollout for the new dashboard widgets? 2) can we confirm retention windows for error-analysis views (prod vs staging) so infra can size storage?

maya: @alex I can own the dashboard widget side (design + API). Will need eng-runtime to ship trace hook endpoints first. timeline: aiming for canary next Tues.

sam: I can take the trace hook work but need clarification on the payload shape. Maya, can you paste the minimal contract?

maya: minimal contract: span_id, trace_id, service, env, timestamp, tags (map). small JSON example: ```json
{"span_id":"s-123","trace_id":"t-456","service":"console-ui","env":"prod","timestamp":1680000000,"tags":{"route":"/dash","lat_ms":12}}
```

lina: For retention sizing — infra wants a decision on prod retention (30/90 days) and sampling for long tails. Current assumption: prod=90d at 10% sample for traces, errors full retention for 30d then aggregate histograms for 90d. Is that acceptable?

maya: That aligns with our cost/quality tradeoff. Proposal: errors full for 30d, aggregated events to 90d; traces sampled 10% prod, 20% staging for QA.

sam: OK. Implementation note: trace hook will accept optional sampled flag to avoid re-sampling downstream. I’ll add that.

alex: To be explicit with ownership and deps:
- Dashboard widgets: owner = maya (design + API)
- Trace hook endpoint + sampled flag: owner = sam (eng-runtime)
- Ingestion & retention policy + storage sizing: owner = lina (eng-platform infra)
- Rollout and canary: owner = alex (program/coord)

infra-bot: deploy scheduled: tracing-hook-service v1.3 -> staging at 2026-03-20T09:00Z (canary) :rocket:

maya: Quick Q — backfill for last 7 days of traces for dashboard demos. Lina, do we have capacity if we run a one-off backfill at 0.5x ingest?

lina: We do but it will spike cost ~+12% for the month. If you can trim sample_rate to 5% for that window, cost drops to ~+3%.

alex: Decision: demo team can do 5% sample backfill. Maya, schedule the backfill window and tell infra when ready.

maya: Will schedule for Wed 03:00-06:00 UTC, will ping infra and demo team once set.

sam: I’ll open a small PR for the sampled flag and wire up the canary config. Will tag @lina for ingester config changes.

alex: Thanks — follow-ups: PR links, canary run outcome, and cost estimate after backfill. If anyone needs to defer, call it out now. :thumbsup:
